architecture.rule: FELYA is the company. PATON is the product and may use functional blue accents. The FELYA wordmark remains monochrome.

principles.title: Human first
principles.rule: The human is the source, measure and acting agent. Technology extends human capability; it does not replace the human in the story.

principles.title: Physical, not abstract
principles.rule: Show mechanics, touch and real hardware. Avoid generic technology symbols and decorative futurism.

principles.title: Calm confidence
principles.rule: Use strong hierarchy, concise statements and deliberate negative space. Authority comes from clarity, not visual volume.

principles.title: Engineering is evidence
principles.rule: Prototypes, mechanisms and verifiable effects support every claim.

logo.anatomyColorRule: Anatomy colors explain meaning only. Production logos stay monochrome.

color.productAccent: PATON Blue explains product, function, focus and active states.
color.strongAccent: Blue Strong is reserved for short labels and high-contrast functional emphasis.
color.rareSignal: Signal Gold marks an exceptional event or explains the logo horizon. It is not a general accent.
restrictions: Do not mechanically invert Light Mode values to create Dark Mode.
Do not apply PATON Blue or Signal Gold to the FELYA wordmark.

modes.rule: Show real hardware, readable mechanisms and honest materials. Do not hide engineering beneath atmospheric effects.
Use blueprint-like linework to explain a specific relationship between people and technology. Keep one scenario, one focal point and deliberate negative space.

sharedRules: Use composition to explain possibility, not to decorate empty space.
Fog follows the subject or functional focal point and is never a generic vignette.

use: Start with the person or action.
Describe what people and machines do.
Prefer concrete verbs and observable effects.

governance.publicationRule: New brand decisions are documented in the private canonical source first, reflected in tokens where applicable and only then exported into public snapshots.

rights.notice: Brand materials are provided as an authoritative reference. Usage remains subject to FELYA approval.
